responsibility: Plan and optionally apply deterministic pruning of stale files in one requested directory.

decisions.volatile_decision: How the current instant is obtained.
change_scenarios: Use a monotonic or simulated time source without changing age policy.
Inject scheduled clock failure without changing application orchestration.

decisions.volatile_decision: How directory entries are listed and deleted.
change_scenarios: Replace local filesystem access with another store without changing prune policy.
Translate a new storage failure without changing domain outcomes.

operations.name: prune
operations.inputs: A directory, age policy, retention count, and explicit apply choice.
operations.outputs: A versioned plan or application result rendered from one result object.
operations.ordering: Candidates and effects are ordered deterministically by path.
operations.idempotency: Preview is read-only; applying the same completed plan again may report missing entries as a typed interruption.
operations.concurrency: No cross-process isolation is promised for the requested directory.
operations.timeout: No wall-time deadline is promised for local filesystem traversal.

operations.name: now
operations.inputs: No explicit value beyond the injected port instance.
operations.ordering: Calls are observed in application sequence.
operations.idempotency: The operation is intentionally time-varying; fakes control the returned sequence.
operations.concurrency: The contract promises no shared mutable state.
operations.timeout: The local adapter performs one host clock read without retry.

operations.name: entries
operations.inputs: The directory bound when the adapter is created.
operations.outputs: A deterministic sequence of validated entry values.
operations.ordering: Entries are sorted by path name.
operations.idempotency: Read-only for a stable external directory state.
operations.concurrency: Concurrent external changes are not isolated.

operations.name: delete
operations.inputs: One entry name previously returned by the same store contract.
operations.ordering: Application applies the deterministic plan in order.
operations.idempotency: Deletion is not idempotent when the entry has already disappeared.
operations.timeout: Each call performs one local deletion without retry.

resource_absence: The application holds no resource beyond one command invocation; the requested directory remains owned by the command user.

recoveries.action: Stop further deletion and return completed and remaining effects in a typed interruption.
recoveries.escalation: The shell renders one structured failure envelope and nonzero exit status.
recoveries.terminal_state: Already completed deletions remain explicit and every unapplied deletion remains listed.
